# Pillow < 13 (2026-10-21): fastembed, the local embedding model, requires
# pillow<13 in every release up to 0.9.0, so it can't be upgraded. IngenMind
# only embeds text; nothing it does decodes an image with Pillow (PDFs are read
# with pypdf, text only). Remove these when fastembed allows Pillow 13.
